subject: Nexus displacement incentives & hosted-API commit playbook
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@nexusanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — displacement ask vs OpenAI/Anthropic

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Nexus Analytics is evaluating a migration from a mix of OpenAI and Anthropic-hosted endpoints to a single vendor for production inference. We run ~1.2B tokens/month across mixed gen/chat workloads and are finalizing procurement in the next 3–4 weeks.

Primary ask: can Redwood provide a competitive displacement package to match / beat our current blended per-token spend (we're currently at ~$0.00085/token blended across vendors) and a clear commit tier ladder? Procurement wants a predictable unit cost and an exit path if latency/quality doesn't match during an initial pilot.

Constraints:
- Data residency: US region only for initial pilot
- Audit logs + SOC2 evidence required before PO
- Procurement timeline: internal approval by 7/10

Would appreciate a short proposal with a couple of options (aggressive short-term match for migration vs longer-term committed discount ladder). Attaching a short procurement Q&A and our expected usage cadence.

Attachments: Nexus_RFP_v3.pdf (procurement Q&A, current vendor invoices snapshot)

Can you send a proposal by EOD tomorrow? If possible, cc your pricing/finance contact.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Head of ML Platforms
Nexus Analytics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@nexusanalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — displacement ask vs OpenAI/Anthropic

Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Really excited about the opportunity to support Nexus at scale. I pulled together two pragmatic paths that teams typically take when displacing existing cloud endpoints: a short-term aggressive match to eliminate migration friction, and a longer-term committed ladder that gives both parties predictability and unit-cost leverage. See the attached proposal and pricing model.

High level (quick summary):
- Option A — Migration Match (fast path):
  - 3-month trial (pilot), 600M token committed minimum
  - Effective first-3-month per-token price: $0.00060 (represents ~29% discount vs your current blend)
  - Includes SOC2 evidence package, per-token usage breakdowns, and 24/7 priority triage during pilot
- Option B — Commit Ladder (scale path):
  - 12-month commitment with quarterly ramping slabs (0–250M, 250–750M, >750M)
  - Starting price: $0.00072/token, laddering to $0.00045/token at >1.5B effective monthly usage after ramp
  - Includes staging credits (first month credit = 10% of committed spend), performance SLAs and a defined escape clause for latency/regression issues

Questions for you before we lock numbers:
1) Is the 1.2B token figure steady-state or peak? Do you expect seasonal spikes (more than 25% variance)?
2) Which model families are you using today (OpenAI gpt-4 equivalent / Anthropic Claude 2-style)? That affects our kernel selection and cost basis.

I've attached: Nexus-RI-Proposal-June30.pdf and pricing-model-v2.xlsx (breakdown by model family and token bands). If you're available, I'd like to run through the two paths in a 30-min call tomorrow morning — I'll include Priyom and Hannah from pricing/enterprise.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick 30-min call to confirm steady-state usage and model families
- Redwood to provide final offer and DocuSign-ready PO/term sheet
- Pilot kickoff within one week of PO (assuming SOC2 evidence accepted)

On timelines: we can prioritize SOC2 evidence and provide a limited evidence bundle within 48 hours for procurement.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Rishi — this is helpful, thanks. A few clarifications from procurement:
- We can approve a pilot PO quickly but legal wants the SOC2 report + an Audit Log export sample included in the proposal.
- We use a mix of "gpt-style" and Claude-like families; primary traffic is gpt-style at ~70%.
- 1.2B is our current blended month; steady-state expectation for our CAS product is ~900M–1.4B depending on campaign activity.

Procurement preference is to start with Option A (fast match) if Redwood can commit to the per-token parity and supply the evidence. If you can put a DocuSign for the 3-month pilot with the token floor, we can route for approval by 7/10.

Attached: Nexus_procurement_QA.xlsx

Olivia

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: NX-2026-058 pricing sensitivity and approval path

Folks — forwarding Olivia's note and our proposal. Quick internal calc + recommendation below (see pricing-model-v2.xlsx attached).

Context: 1.2B blended baseline, pilot ask ~600M tokens over 3 months. Procurement will route to legal once we provide SOC2 evidence.

Risk and margin:
- Option A (match to $0.00060 for pilot) is dilutive in the short term but drives displacement and upsell. We model ~12% net margin at current kernel assumptions if we absorb the first-month credit.
- Option B (12-month commit ladder) preserves margin while giving Nexus predictable economics; requires finance sign-off for 18–22% blended discount at scale.

Recommendation: Offer Option A as a time-limited pilot with the following guardrails:
- 3-month pilot, 600M committed tokens (monthly floor 150M)
- Per-token for pilot months: $0.00060
- One month credit worth 10% of committed spend applied after month 1 (non-refundable, applied to second invoice)
- Standard SLA for latency (p95 < 250ms for gen endpoints) and a regression clause (30-day remediation or termination)

Need Hannah / Vivek to confirm: 1) SOC2 evidence packet release OK, and 2) approval to price Option A at $0.00060 for the pilot (finance tolerance).

--Priyom

- Term: 3-month pilot, commit 600M tokens (150M/mo floor)
- Price: $0.00060 per token for pilot months
